env_allowlist.HOME: inherited runner home; used only to address the hash-verified pinned Lean toolchain

recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean invocation runs inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and only a fresh temporary module directory writable. The checker performs local file, hash, and Git-object reads only and invokes no Lake, update, build, clone, fetch, or network operation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line UTF-8 PASS/OPEN/FAIL-CLOSED summary bound by validation-receipt.json

recipes.expected_output_policy: Six exact lines report three narrow passes, one open-root boundary, and two fail-closed assurance boundaries.
recipes.scope_boundary: Trust-zero, network-isolated, fresh-output replay of the exact statement, partial L2 proof bodies, and root composition conditional on two unproved all-p packages. It covers zero frozen obligations because M0349-L-L2 lacks an exact frozen type, and it supplies no weak-(1,1), interpolation, all-p proof, cold release replay, or distinct-runner independence.

status_boundary: Validation-only worker recipe. It adds no mathematical proof, accepts no predecessor, closes no obligation or root, and cannot supply release or master acceptance.
